title: Same-root naming retains an old claim fence and committed-input test registration still refuses after the prescribed refresh
outcome: Official same-root naming reconciles the live claim fence used by committed-input registration, so a clean check on the current named root can register without clearing the root, bypassing verification or retrying a stale binding.
acceptance: When a live claim on the same work run has a newer fence, official naming of the same root reconciles the retained registration authority; a clean committed-input run can register under the current canonical claim. Existing work/store/run/root/generation fences and release or displacement refusals remain enforced.

Regression coverage exercises the stale-fence refusal, official same-root refresh and subsequent registration through production entry points, and negative controls prevent a released, displaced, foreign or stale run from borrowing the refreshed authority. The fix does not mutate historical evaluations, verification records or seals.

The exact repaired candidate has the required independent source-review pair and green full gate before landing; the tracker records the original Windows registration refusals separately from any later validation.

completion.summary: Exact repaired tree landed/pushed as master0d4d8061 after independent pair and qualified originalFULL63002; clean release installed. Same-root naming reconciles current claim fence and preserves strict controls. Runtime activation/WindowsEO50 remain on openparent.
